request.statement:
### Dialect Reference Normalization with Decision Consistency

Implement `normalize_reference(tokens, separators, costs, switch_cost, min_parts, max_parts, case)`.

Inputs:
- `tokens`: nonempty list of `(kind, text)` pairs; each token's original index is its list position
- `kind`: one of `"N"`, `"D"`, `"P"`, `"S"`
- `separators`: nonempty string of distinct ASCII characters, excluding backslash
- `costs`: mapping from every separator character to `(split_cost, keep_cost)`; costs are nonnegative integers
- `switch_cost`: nonnegative integer
- `1 <= min_parts <= max_parts <= 200`
- `case`: `"preserve"`, `"lower"`, or `"upper"`
- Total token-text length is at most 6000
- Escapes are valid: every backslash in an `N` token has a following character

Expand tokens from left to right:
- `N`: backslash escapes the following character, which becomes ordinary name material. Each unescaped separator becomes a soft separator. Remaining maximal runs become name material.
- `D`: text is exactly one separator character and becomes a hard separator.
- `P`: nonempty text becoming punctuation material.
- `S`: text is exactly `"*"` and becomes wildcard material.

Normalization removes escaping backslashes. Apply `case` only to ASCII letters originating as `N` material. Punctuation, retained separators, and wildcard text remain unchanged.

Interpretation rules:
- A hard separator is a mandatory part boundary.
- A soft separator `c` is either a boundary costing `split_cost`, or retained literal material costing `keep_cost`.
- Within each region separated by hard separators, soft-separator decisions form one sequence, even when ordinary material occurs between them. After the first decision, add `switch_cost` whenever its boundary/retained choice differs from the preceding soft decision. A hard separator resets this sequence.
- Every ordinary part must begin and end with name material.
- Punctuation and retained separators are allowed only between name material in the same part.
- Adjacent material without a boundary belongs to the same part.
- A wildcard must be the sole material of the final part.
- Empty parts are forbidden.
- The final part count must be within `[min_parts, max_parts]`.

Choose by:
1. Minimum total base and switching cost
2. Minimum number of parts
3. Lexicographically smallest soft-decision vector in left-to-right order, encoding boundary as `0` and retained as `1`

Return `None` if no interpretation is valid. Otherwise return one `(text, indices)` pair per part. `text` is concatenated normalized material. `indices` is the increasing list of distinct original token indices contributing retained material. Boundary separators contribute no index; one token may contribute to multiple parts.

The source must define `normalize_reference`, accept positional or keyword arguments, and use only the standard library. It must perform no I/O and use no mutable global state or nondeterminism.
